Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Four Super Heroes, exposed to cosmic radiation in an unforeseen accident
and granted superhuman abilities, 
have gathered once again to defend Earth from impending crisis!

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the July Update,
featuring the Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps inspired theme.

 

New Uniforms have been added for the unique Super Heroes of the Fantastic Four team: Mister Fantastic, Invisible Woman, Human Torch, and The Thing. The incredibly tough hero, The Thing, who can lift anything with his immense strength, also receives a Tier-4 Advancement.

 

Additionally, a New World Boss Legend+ has arrived, 
where Thanos leads his Black Order to destroy the whole universe.
We’ve also prepared a New C.T.P. and more to power up the heroes.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 

▣ Four New Uniforms


To celebrate the Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps inspired update,
four new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Mister Fantastic <Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps>, 
Invisible Woman <Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps>, 
Human Torch <Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps>, 
and The Thing <Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps>.  
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The four new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <July Update Celebration Event> 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 


▣ The Thing Tier-4

 

Tier-4 advancement has been added to The Thing. Possessing not only strength and durability but also extreme mental fortitude, he never backs down from a fight against the enemy.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Crystal, Maximus, and Karnak Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Crystal, Maximus, and Karnak will acquire
Potential Awakening & Transcendence through the July Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New World Boss: Legend+ <Thanos & The Black Order> Release 

 

Leading his formidable Black Order, Thanos, the warlord from Titan, 
has arrived as the fourth challenge in World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.

 

 

- Thanos’s ambition to destroy the entire multiverse must be stopped!

 

1. Agents can challenge <Thanos & The Black Order> from Difficulty 1 after clearing the unlock Challenges.
- Unlock Requirements:
Clear Story stage 8-3, Own three or more Tier-4 heroes, Clear all World Boss Challenges
- Stages in multiples of 10 will be unlocked after completing designated challenges, such as including specific heroes.

 

 

 

2. Thanos & The Black Order’s Conquer Level can be achieved up to 200, and the conquer effect can be upgraded along with acquiring Odin's Blessing Chest, Dimension Chest: C.T.P., and Tier-3 growth materials.
- The basic damage Thanos & The Black Order receive increases as the Conquer Level increases.
- Conquer Effects that apply to Thanos & The Black Order, according to the Conquer Level of Black Dwarf & Maw, have been added.

 

 

3. In this stage, you’ll face Thanos and the six members of the Black Order.
Stop their assault and claim the rewards!

 

 


​- Depending on the progress, the Black Order, under the command of Thanos will unleash a powerful attack.


4. Clear Thanos & The Black Order to acquire various rewards.
​- The Mighty C.T.P. of Energy, Regeneration, Destruction, Judgment, Authority, Greed, Refinement, and Insight can be acquired when clearing Thanos & The Black Order.
-  Cosmic Cube Fragments can be acquired at a 100% rate from the World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.
- Agents can obtain a 'Special World Boss Loot' as the first clear reward when clearing each Floor from the 10th Floor and above.
- Agents can obtain either Thanos’s exclusive Artifact (Ruler of the Universe) or an Emblem: Thanos as the first clear reward for every 10 Floors from the 10th Floor and above.

 

 


▣ New C.T.P. & Reforging

 

A new Custom Gear, ‘C.T.P. of Competition’ has been added!
It influences damage increase effects based on your hero’s Instinct stats. 
Also, be sure to experience the powerful ‘Fury’ reforge option, 
which increases your hero’s all damage and grants Guard Break Immunity!
* The options are based on the maximum stats.
* One of the two reforge options will be selected randomly based on the chances.
* The C.T.P. of Competition can be acquired from the [Store] - [Dimension Chest] - [Custom Gear Chest] menu after the July Update.

 

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

After the July Update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Crystal, Maximus and Karnak will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 


- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 
Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[July Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

  

 
▣ Update Products

 

1.  Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 7/15 Maintenance - 8/12 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 7/15 Maintenance - 8/12 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

2. The price for the ‘Guided Quest - Special Plus’ product has been adjusted from 5,750 crystals to 2,500 crystals.

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Shadowland: The following have been improved
① An icon to check first-clear rewards for floors 36 and above has been added.
② Soul of the Faltine has been added to the item sale list in the Shadowland Shop.

 

 

③ The rewards for Shadowland Chest have been updated.
- C.T.P. rewards added and acquisition chance increased
- Odin's Blessing rewards added
- Existing Hidden Ticket and Uniform Upgrade Kit rewards removed
- Various growth material items added (Godstones, Power of Demiurge, etc.)

 


2. Left and right arrows have been added to the hero’s skill upgrade pop-up, improving the convenience of checking skills.

 

 

3. Alliance (Support Tab): The daily limit for items you can support/request has been partially improved.
- Requests made before the update cannot be re-requested with the changed item quantity after the update.
- The number of times you have supported an item requested by an alliance member before the update will not be reset.


4. Alliance Battle: If you fail to clear the Normal Mode, the text “Challenge the Record Available!” will now appear on the menu screen.

 

5. The damage from “Corrosive Gas,” one of the Stage Hazard in Zombie Survival, has been reduced.

 

6. Human Torch’s Tier-4 Striker Skill name has been changed.
- Previous: Endless Flame
- New: Flame Resonance

 

7. The system has been improved so that some S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive collectibles, previously obtainable only from specific World Bosses, can now also be acquired from other World Bosses.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. For Agents who participated in a World Event on the day of the recent update maintenance but did not receive rewards, Agent Tokens will be distributed after the maintenance is complete.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
